title: Design a human branch-first install
summary: Provide a GitHub-web walkthrough from a pinned version to a dedicated branch, with a collision check and a reviewable first idea and feature.

origin.source: Provenistem standalone planning and repository audit, 2026-11-20.

benefits: Makes installation usable without a terminal.
risks: A file-copy guide can omit required files or leave the user on the wrong branch.

evidence.claim: v0.0.2 documents a manual isolated copy and a read-only planner.
